section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Sociocultural Attitudes Towards Appearance Questionnaire-3 (SATAQ-3), a 30-item instrument used to assess internalisation of appearance ideals and perceived pressure to attain societal ideals. The text notes that the Brazilian Portuguese translation of the SATAQ-3 has adequate psychometric properties in university women, with all subscales showing Cronbach alpha values greater than .84. This is a methods section describing measurement instruments rather than reporting study results or participant demographics.
